staged.body: An empty ledger divides by zero here: `len(items)` is 0 and `average_unit_price` raises `ZeroDivisionError` instead of reporting anything. Decide what an empty inventory averages to (`None`, or `0.0` if the callers can live with it) and return that before dividing.

`range(0, n + 1)` walks `n + 1` positions: the default `top_by_value(ledger)` returns four items, not three, and any ledger with fewer than `n + 1` items raises `IndexError`. Filter out the excluded SKUs first, then slice: `[i for i in ranked if i.sku not in exclude][:n]`.
Two of these three helpers break on ordinary input: an empty ledger crashes the average, and the top-N returns one item too many or runs off the end of the list. Fix both before this merges.
